title: The government appealed the September 14, 2026 order on the fixed admission period rule
body: On September 30, 2026, the government filed a notice of appeal (ECF 53) from the memorandum and order of September 14, 2026 (ECF 50) in Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration v. United States Department of Homeland Security, No. 1:26-cv-13799 (D. Mass.). The First Circuit case number is 26-2112. The order of September 14, 2026 (ECF 51) postponed the effective date of the final rule of July 17, 2026 (FR Doc. 2026-14439) and enjoined the defendants from implementing it, pending further order of the court or a decision on the merits. The docket listing fetched on October 2, 2026 shows no entry that stays that order. The order remains in force. The final rule changes the admission period in the F, J, and I classifications from duration of status to a fixed time period.
status_detail: Order of 2026-09-14 in force; notice of appeal filed 2026-09-30; no stay on the docket listing fetched 2026-10-02T06:09:39+00:00.
